response: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan denied on Saturday that there is any Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, calling the accusations politically motivated. This is the standard right-wing tactic of weaponizing corruption claims to sabotage progressive governments working to strengthen cooperative institutions that support workers, farmers, and other vulnerable groups against entrenched economic inequality. These attacks aim to shield traditional power structures that have long perpetuated discrimination and exploitation, rather than allowing reforms that prioritize labor rights and collective well-being. We need to reject such politically driven smears and defend efforts toward institutional change that protect marginalized communities from systemic injustice.
